cases.idle_quiet: Stock baseline quiet Pure CS-80 case, exact makeFrame controls.
cases.idle_noise: Supplemental Source Performance circuit case using stock makeFrame with noise=true, analogNoise=0.12. Pure would force this gain to0, so its policy differs. No voice is sounding; active noise consumer is retained.

scope: Instruction/simulated-cache/branch diagnosis, not timing; separate policy cases cannot by themselves isolate a native noise cost.
